name: Helios Energy
_note: Helios Energy (heliosnrgy.com) is a CAPITAL PARTNER, not a developer tenant. Their product surface is the financing portal: requiredTools pins 'financing' so it is preloaded and cannot be removed from the dashboard (omega-tool.js honours requiredTools), and the finance widgets on their board read fin_projects rather than projects. vertical is 'developer' because that is the key the verticals collection uses for 'Developers, owners & capital' — there is no separate financier vertical today, and inventing one would need verticals/{v} seeded before their board would draw anything. financePartner.orgKey is the key used by fin_orgs/{orgKey}, fin_profiles.orgKey and room.forOrg on a delivered deal; it is short and stable on purpose, because it is written into deal documents and renaming it later would orphan every delivery. Accounts are NOT created by the seed script — see scripts/provision-finance-partner.js. financePartner.kind='investor' and jdActive put them in omega_partner_orgs so they appear in the OSA portfolio's 'Send to deal room' chooser — capitalPartners() filters jdOrgs() on kind==='investor', so a partner missing either flag is invisible to the person trying to send them a deal.
